name: Pinnacle Propane
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public pinnaclepropane.com pages (home, Billing and Payments, Customer portal login); no sign-in, no forms submitted. The customer portal is reached by picking a state and branch ('Let's start by selecting your branch'); each branch link opens a third-party portal (webhub.rccbi.com) whose sign-in form renders client-side, so the sign-in identifier and password rules are not known and the family defaults are kept. Portal features listed publicly: manage personal information and payment methods, monitor usage and tank levels, pay bills / view transaction history, place orders. Automatic monthly payments are described as direct bank transfers (bank only). Paperless billing starts by giving an email address in the portal. Budget Plan (even monthly payments across the year) and PreBuy Plan (pay upfront at the pre-season price, with AutoFill). Balance questions: +1-972-444-0300; 1-800-633-8253 is the emergency line only. Refunds take 10-14 business days. No guest payment is offered on the public pages. Fees, late charges and account closing are not published on the pages used, so they are left at the family defaults. Review 2026-10-10: labels.help removed because 'Billing and Payments' duplicated the family 'Billing & Payments' item in the signed-in header nav; the Billing and Payments help article stays in the public nav.

guest_pay.note: Online payments are made in the customer portal after you select your branch and log in. For balance questions call +1-972-444-0300.

autopay.note: Automatic monthly payments are drawn by direct transfer from your bank account.

paperless.note: Add your email address in the customer portal to start paperless billing.

help.title: Billing and payments
paragraphs: Existing customers pay in the Pinnacle Propane customer portal: choose your state and branch, log in, then make a payment with a saved credit card or bank account. The portal also shows balances and transaction history, and the Pinnacle Propane customer app lets you manage your account on the go.

To check your balance by phone, call +1-972-444-0300. If your monthly bill has not arrived, send the customer inquiry form and it will be sent to you by email or post. Refunds take 10 to 14 business days.
steps: Open Customer login and select your branch.
Log in to the customer portal.
Choose Make a payment and pick your saved card or bank account.

help.title: Automatic monthly payments
paragraphs: Set up direct bank transfers in the customer portal and your bill is paid automatically each month.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Log in to the customer portal and provide your email address to receive your bills electronically instead of by mail.

help.title: Budget Plan and PreBuy Plan
paragraphs: The Budget Plan spreads your propane costs evenly across the year so you pay the same amount each month.
With the PreBuy Plan you pay once, up front, for the year's propane at the pre-season price and get AutoFill deliveries. Ask your local branch about enrolling.

extra.intent: Using the Pinnacle Propane website's help pages, find the phone number to call for an account balance inquiry. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
